name: donghyuns-agent-tools
description: Donghyun's personal plugin marketplace for coding agents

plugins.name: spec-mirror
plugins.description: Six-skill safety net: generate, drift-check, lint, test-stub, coverage-audit, and scope-walk E2E specs against the current implementation

plugins.name: qa-operator
plugins.description: Delegated browser QA operator: plan, run, monitor, triage, and optionally repair acceptance checks from requirements with evidence dashboards

plugins.name: feature-intake
plugins.description: Screenshot-backed product intake for external PoCs, demos, prototypes, and VoC experiments before product integration, with page-walk, control-reaction, PoC fidelity, implementation specs, and static web reports

plugins.name: ui-operator
plugins.description: Evidence-backed UI iteration operator for baseline/current web, mobile web, native mobile, local session, and requirement parity comparisons during product UI changes

plugins.name: dev-discipline
plugins.description: Evidence-driven development discipline for strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR TDD with co-located executable specifications and contract tests for fakes

plugins.name: thread-keeper
plugins.description: Branch a conversation point into a capsule another session continues from, merge results back, and always show where you are

plugins.name: wireflow
plugins.description: Clickable wireflow review: an auto-laid-out journey board with the primary path on a spine, exception and open-decision bands, chips for state, metrics, experiments, and notifications, and a log list of events, then mock screens per device, with scenario checks, fix proposals, and copyable change requests
